title: Xometry Asia, SLM aluminium AlSi10Mg material sheet
notes: One-page service sheet downloaded and read as text on 2026-11-12 (SHA-256 of the file read: fa7a24f7b937e85afb3744e24a74c09fecf6076b28e3736938d676edade08fad; the file is not stored). It states a typical achievable part accuracy of plus or minus 100 micrometres, a smallest wall of about 0.3 to 0.4 mm, and roughness as built and cleaned of Ra 6 to 10 and Rz 30 to 40 micrometres (Rz 50 to 60 after micro shot-peening). The footnotes its table refers to are missing, the machine and layer thickness behind those values are not stated, and its own header gives a 0.1 mm default layer and a tolerance of 0.2 % of length. The provenance of the figures is therefore unknown; they are kept as indicative only.
